filingText: Tela Medical Devices, Inc. files this registration statement on Form S-8 relating to inducement awards made outside its stockholder-approved equity incentive plan. Stock options to purchase 75,000 shares were granted to 1 newly-hired employee on March 3, 2026. Restricted stock units covering 6,600 shares were granted to 12 newly-hired employees on March 3, 2026. The awards were approved as employment inducement awards under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).
